{{Quote|Convey my dissatisfaction with Commander Stavan on his performance. Inform him that he has been removed from command and will be reassigned. That is all.|Galak Fyyar's transmission to the Kejim outpost|audio=Galaktransmission.flac|<ref name="JO" />}}
'''Stavan''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Galak Fyyar]] of the [[Empire Reborn]], a faction of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. Holding a [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Commander/Legends|commander]], he was stationed in an [[Kejim Outpost|outpost]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kejim]]<ref name="JO" /> around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="date">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' places the events in-game 8 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which takes place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the game takes place in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].</ref> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] named [[Kyle Katarn]] was [[Mission to Kejim|investigating]] the outpost, Admiral Fyyar made a transmission to the outpost, in which he expressed disappointment with Stavan's performance and instructed that Stavan be removed from command and reassigned.<ref name="JO" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast}}
During his time investigating the Kejim outpost, Katarn stumbled upon the transmission involving Stavan and several other messages while examining a communications console.<ref name="JO" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Stavan was mentioned in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'', in which he did not appear but was mentioned in a transmission. While the communications console containing the message could be accessed by Kyle Katarn&mdash;the player character&mdash;finding the console was optional and did not affect the outcome of the game. However, this article was written with the assumption of 100 percent game completion.
